flows.name: P08-P09 复验：同意保存、撤销一次、重新打开

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '同意'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const i = document.querySelector('dialog[open] input[name="draftName"]'); if (!i) return false; i.value = '第二批 Part two 验收草稿（第二轮）'; return true; })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.wp-history-select'); if (!s) return false; s.value = 'undo'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '打开草稿'); if (!btn) return false; btn.id = 'pt-open-drafts-btn'; return true; })()

(() => { const list = document.querySelector('dialog[open] [data-draft-list]'); if (!list) return false; const rows = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('div')); const row = rows.find(r => (r.textContent || '').includes('第二批 Part two 验收草稿（第二轮）') && r.querySelector('button')); if (!row) return false; row.querySelector('button').id = 'pt-open-target'; return true; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root .region-name')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return names.includes('设备耗电明细') && names.includes('机房运行日报') && names.includes('设备耗电排名'); })()
